title: Policy spec: network_profiles
description: WS-02 (with WS-09). Validates Policy.spec when policyType = network_profiles. The controller renders CiliumNetworkPolicy ar-<body>-egress from the profile named in AgentRun.spec.networkProfile (network.md section 3). Placeholders {env}, {region}, {org} are substituted from controller configuration. Tenant layers may only remove destinations (ADR-013 tightening).

alwaysAllowed.description: Destinations added to every profile (runner-sandbox, OTLP, artifacts and transcripts run buckets). The session bucket is per profile (XD-FIX-R1-213).

tenants.description: If present, only these tenants may use the profile.

roles.description: If present, only runs with one of these C-CRD roles may use the profile (eval-snapshot: [eval]; takeover: [takeover]).

packageMirrorRepos.description: Artifactory repository classes this profile may use on the package-mirror host (enforced by Artifactory permissions on the same host, agent-capabilities.md section 7).

fqdn.description: matchName; exactly one of fqdn, fqdnPattern, endpoints

dnsName.description: name to allow in the DNS rule for this in-cluster service
